question: What essential nature is attributed to the power described as the thread of creation and dissolution?
premises: The form extends from the root onward.
It is characterized as a lotus-fiber thread.
inference: The described power is essentially the continuous thread of creation and dissolution from the root onward.
uncertainties: The referent of this feminine compound is implied from the preceding Kāmakalā context.
plain_english: She is of the nature of the lotus-fiber thread of creation and dissolution, beginning from the root.
